title: Motorola Signature 12GB RAM/256GB Storage $897.30, Edge 70 8GB/256GB $539.10 Delivered @ Mobileciti
body:
Deal: Motorola Signature 12GB RAM/256GB Storage $897.30, Edge 70 8GB/256GB $539.10 Delivered @ Mobileciti

[shxhshzhz] Yes. It was missed when posting. I did not neg your comment
[Yash984] This is the most underrated phone ever. I bought 1TB 16GB model from India for $1070 AUD on ebay. And boy I have never loved any mobile phone more than this one. The pictures this phone takes is DSLR quality. It is so sleek only 7.1 mm thick, extremely well optimised battery 5200mah which lasts me 3 days easily with normal usage. It has all the bells and whistles that a modern day smart phone offers. The only thing it has lagged behind is marketing because No one knows about this phone here in Australia. For someone who is in doubt, just go ahead and buy, you won't regret.
[Yash984] The above comment was for Motorola signature
[OzSikh] Did you buy from eBay Australia and had it delivered here in OZ?
[Yash984] Yes, bought it from eBay Australia but seller was in India, Punjab . Phone came here in 3 days. Via DHL
[arthurbach4] Completely agree. Phenomonal phone, can't fault it.
[drillvoice] I have a pixel 10, how do you think this would compare?
[Yash984] Never used pixel..but from what I have heard they have pretty average battery life
[rwt] Same naked crappy Android, similar performance, better battery life.
Just keep in mind the Moto can be a bit smelly during the first week.
[wallaby12] Second this! The Signature is absolutely epic. Piece of art in terms of built and look (first phone I'm rocking without any case). And how refined it is and light. Pictures absolutely stunning. Battery top notch. People thinking it's just another Motorola, like whatever phone but in fact it's another level, something they didn't have in offer before.
[Agret] I imported China exclusive OnePlus Ace 2 Pro (24gb ram/1tb storage, basically the Chinese OnePlus 12R) from AliExpress and it's been great but Motorola has a newer CPU (mines snapdragon 8 gen2) - idk why they make the best specs country exclusive
[xrailgun] in my experience it's more common that Australia gets some exclusive cut-down version (most other regions in the world get 12gb edge 70 for half the price of Australia's 8gb).
[wako] Are you on Telstra? Does it get WiFi calling and SMS over WiFi?
[mr_asstight] What about the curved screen? Doesn't that suck?
[dontpanic] If it had a flat screen I probably would have got it. I've had nothing but bad experiences with curved screens (functional screen protectors are expensive and difficult to apply… and the screens are expensive to repair/replace if they break).
[ATTS] Would be better than the s26 ultra? Or pixel 11 XL pro
[dimsum2] I got the phone last week from Telstra and it's truly such a great phone (was on a S22 Ultra before).
So light weight, great camera and battery life. The UI is far better than Samsung too. Close to stock Android but with some very practical additions.
Very lacking in the accessories though. Where is everyone getting their cases and screenprotectors from?
[s1Lence] 1TB is crazy, got a link for that or the store name on ebay?
[Michael1983] good price… i'm going to get one… my wife told me to buy new fans instead… 4k+1.5k for electrician for haiku l from big ass fans… probably 2027 resolution..
[cosjav] Is the Samsung Galaxy S25 FE better than the Edge 70 if you don't care about weight and the extra 128GB storage? (same price at Mobileciti or cheaper at Kogan)
[scrimshaw] Samsung has a higher tier CPU. SOC in the Edge is mid-tier
Plus more OS updates.
[Yash984] I ditched my Samsung s24 Ultra.. worst camera, when you compare to this
[p3r514n] Excellent price for the Signature. Highly underrated phone.
[drillvoice] Telstra has this for $1199 with bonus $600 trade in credit, you could also get them to price match JB HiFi to make it about $400 total ($999-$600) then you get actual trade in value but you also pay one month fees ($69).
[xrailgun] is this for Signature or Edge 70? so is it about ~$469 in the end or are there other early termination fees?
[drillvoice] It's the signature, sorry. About $469 in the end I believe. I haven't done this myself but others discussed it on the previous Motorola thread. No early termination fees.
[drillvoice] I believe you need to be on a monthly plan, then pay with bank deposit, not card, and the credit is transferred to your bank account. I haven't done this myself but others discussed it on the last signature deal.
[Armaghan] Trade in credit, you mean have to give them any phone or any particular phone for 600 credit ?
[Kenji777] I just chatted with them but one of the agent said they are not able to do the price match on this item. I will try instore tomorrow.
[drillvoice] From what I read they can only price match once you've bought the phone. What did the agent say?
[revheadgl] Now we are getting close to my desired Motorols Signature spend:)
Going to hold out til BF or Boxing Day. Might be wishful thinking, but $750-$799 outright for a 512GB and I am all in!
[shxhshzhz] Motorola highest discount is usually 50% so the RRP$1699 512GB would be closer to $850
[revheadgl] True, but I am working from the Edge 50 Neo, which was I think was about 60 off at one point? Which is still is a great phone in it's own right.
[Guybrush57] Does the Signature still have the rattle?
[GooseLord] Yep the ois camera rattle is pretty loud
[shutuptakemymoney101] I've been using mine since launch, besides shaking the phone on purpose with my ear next to it I've never heard any rattling coming from the phone.
[JDKC] How does the camera compare to a pixel 9 pro? The camera is the only thing preventing me from jumping ship to say Samsung, so if this is better then I'll be keen to finally ditch pixel
[shutuptakemymoney101] I'd say the camera is better on the Signature than the pixel spec wise but the photo processing on a pixel is generally head and shoulders above the competition.
[JDKC] Thank you.
Forgive me ignorance… to the uninformed (i.e me lol) do you think photos will look better on the pixel or the Signature
[Agret] You can download Google camera mod apk which lets you use the Google camera app on other phones, would be better on the Motorola since it uses the same processing algorithms (using Google camera) but with a better camera sensor.
[shutuptakemymoney101] I came across from a Pixel 7, I like the photos better on the Signature but the Pixel I'm comparing it against is quite a number of generations old now.
[p3r514n] https://www.dxomark.com/smartphones/Motorola/Signature
[Yash984] Just check the link DXOMARK
https://www.dxomark.com/smartphones/Motorola/Signature
[MelbBoy] Been using this phone for a while now, and it has been fab. Amazing value and as good as phones twice its price.
[shutuptakemymoney101] Yep, I gotta agree and praise the Motorola Signature as well.
I bought mine on product launch here in Australia (I'm usually pretty firmly in the Pixel camp) and am so happy I decided to try the Motorola.
[milobob] Is it wishful thinking to have the signature specs but in a smaller form factor?
[whyisave] Motorola announces a partnership with GrapheneOS Foundation (March 2026)
https://motorolanews.com/motorola-three-new-b2b-solutions-at…
[MKBHD] Found the comment I was looking for!!!
I'll be buying a Signature in 2027. Not for $1500 through I'll wait for 40% off too. Soooo may be closer to 2028 😅
[Musabbir99] Guys is it true the signature has odd issues with haptics? Even compared to other high end Motorola products? Mainly for typing on the screen.
[shutuptakemymoney101] What have you heard/read, what are you worried about?
A number of posters above praising the phone (as I am) and no mention of issues with haptics.
